nodes.title: System Responsibilities & Boundaries
nodes.summary: - Separation of Concerns: Domain models are strictly isolated. No service accesses another microservice's datastore directly.

nodes.title: Cross-Service Invariants
nodes.summary: Zero Direct DB Access: Cross-domain queries are executed via RPCs or asynchronous event stream materialized views. Distributed Idempotency: Inter-service mutative calls carry unique idempotency keys to guarantee at-most-once execution across retries.

nodes.summary: sequenceDiagram autonumber actor User as End User participant GW as API Gateway Ingress participant Auth as Auth Sentinel participant Pay as Payment Gateway participant Bus as Kafka Broker User->>GW: POST /checkout (Bearer Token) GW->>Auth: Validate JWT & Claims (RS256) Auth-->>GW: Token Valid (User ID, Scopes) GW->>Pay: POST /api/v1/charge (Idempotency-Key) Pay->>Pay: Acquire Redis Mutex Lock Pay->>Pay: Write Serializable DB Ledger Pay->>Bus: Publish payment.settled Event Pay-->>GW: HTTP 201 Created (Transaction ID) GW-->>User: 200 OK (Checkout Complete).

nodes.title: Messaging Backbone & Event Catalog
nodes.summary: Asynchronous decoupling is enforced through message broker topics. Services publish immutable domain events without knowledge of downstream subscribers:.

nodes.title: Distributed Data Consistency & Sagas
nodes.summary: - Dual-Entry Ledger: Financial mutations use strict serializable isolation within Auth Sentinel Service. - Compensating Transactions: Failed downstream calls trigger reverse compensation events to unwind intermediate allocations.

nodes.title: Prerequisites
nodes.summary: - Docker & Docker Compose: v2.20+ - Host Memory: Minimum 8GB recommended to run all containerized services concurrently - Git: Configured with access to all member repositories.

nodes.title: Unified Docker Compose Specification
nodes.summary: Run all microservices together in an isolated bridge network: version: '3.8' networks: checkout-mesh-mesh: driver: bridge services: auth-sentinel: build: context: ../auth-sentinel containername: auth-sentinel ports: - "8080:8080" environment: - PORT=8080 - ENV=development - SYSTEMNAME=checkout-mesh networks: - checkout-mesh-mesh payment-gateway: build: context: ../payment-gateway containername: payment-gateway ports: - "8080:8080" environment: - PORT=8080 - ENV=development - SYSTEMNAME=checkout-mesh networks: - checkout-mesh-mesh redis: image: redis:7-alpine containername: checkout-mesh-redis ports: - "6379:6379" networks: - checkout-mesh-mesh postgres: image: postgres:16-alpine containername: checkout-mesh-postgres environment: - POSTGRESPASSWORD=postgres - POSTGRESDB=checkout-mesh ports: - "5432:5432" networks: - checkout-mesh-mesh.

nodes.title: Quickstart Instructions
nodes.summary: Clone all member repositories side by side: mkdir checkout-mesh && cd checkout-mesh git clone <urltoauth-sentinel> && git clone <urltopayment-gateway> 2. Boot the complete microservice mesh: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d --build 3.
